content.title: ‘Heated Rivalry’’s Hudson Williams Brings GF to Oscars Party
content.text: The Oscars After-party Got Heated Photo: Neilson Barnard/Getty Images The Heated Rivalry cast being fawned over by celebrities at a fancy Hollywood party? Likely place for them to be! Hudson Williams, who also attended the Academy Awards earlier that night, and his longtime girlfriend Katelyn Rose Larson made their red-carpet debut together at the Vanity Fair Oscar Party. The night out comes just a little over a month after their social-media hard launch, when Williams posted a Valentine’s Day Instagram Story saying that Larson had been “with me since my 2000 gold Mazda Protégé smoked and squealed and I had no job.” Something’s always smoking or squealing with these boys, huh? When asked by Etalk Canada on the Oscars red carpet about how his DMs have changed since that relationship reveal, he said, “Honestly, I didn’t even check the DMs. I’m sure they are probably the exact same. But just to see everyone kind of take her in stride and all the lovely fans supporting her, even though she’s not trying to be out there or be perceived — she’s always like, ‘I don’t want to be perceived!’” Luckily, Williams was also joined by someone slightly more willing to be perceived: his Heated Rivalry co-star, Connor Storrie, who posed with Williams on the Vanity Fair party red carpet in their respective black sheer blouses. Williams’s chiffon train did take some wear and tear when it was accidentally stepped on by director Nia DaCosta, to which Williams said, “Nia DaCosta! I’m not watching Bone Temple!” François Arnaud was also in attendance, but there was no sign of the real diva of Heated Rivalry, Christina Chang (who played legendary momager Yuna Hollander).
